text:
Under the 2-service limit, the best plan I found misses 7 (episode, follower) pairs and costs $159.07. I did not prove that 7 is the minimum.

```json
{"periods": [{"serviceId": "kestrel", "start": "2026-11-05"}, {"serviceId": "lumen", "start": "2026-11-19"}, {"serviceId": "kestrel", "start": "2026-12-05"}, {"serviceId": "tidewell", "start": "2026-12-21"}, {"serviceId": "orbit", "start": "2027-01-05"}, {"serviceId": "kestrel", "start": "2027-01-21"}, {"serviceId": "orbit", "start": "2027-02-05"}, {"serviceId": "kestrel", "start": "2027-02-21"}, {"serviceId": "tidewell", "start": "2027-03-05"}, {"serviceId": "kestrel", "start": "2027-03-21"}]}
```

**Cost:** 5 Kestrel+ ($89.95) + 1 Lumen ($15.49) + 2 Tidewell ($17.98) + 2 Orbit ($21.98) = $145.40 new spend. Adding Pebble Kids' 5 auto-renewals ($39.95) gives the $159.07 total, which includes Pebble's required, unlisted renewals.

**Kestrel+ is needed almost all the time.** Eli has only 2 days to watch. Both Kestrel+ shows (The Amber Kingdom, then The Salt Harbor) need access nearly continuously from Nov 7 to Apr 4. So Kestrel+ fills one of the two slots almost the whole time, and everything else shares the other slot.

**How the other slot is used:**
- **Nov 19 – Dec 18:** Lumen is renewed so all three can watch Amber Garden (leaving Dec 21).
- **Dec 21 – Jan 20:** Tidewell covers The Velvet Harbor episodes 2–7.
- **Jan 5 – Jan 20:** Kestrel+ pauses here, so Tidewell and Orbit can run side by side. Orbit then continues to Mar 4 for all of The Paper Meridian.
- **Jan 21:** Kestrel+ resumes.
- **Mar 5 – Apr 4:** Tidewell returns for Salt Atlas (leaving Mar 19).

**Daily limit check:** No day has more than 2 non-required services with access.

**The 7 missed pairs** (each one is forced by the 2-service limit):
- Northern Circuit for Tom: Orbit can't fit in November.
- The Velvet Harbor episode 1 for Priya and Eli, and episode 2 for Eli.
- The Paper Meridian episode 1 for Eli.
- The Salt Harbor episode 1 for Eli.
- Quiet Atlas for Priya: Lumen and Tidewell can't both fit in early March. Tidewell wins because Salt Atlas has 3 followers.

Everything else, including Paper Harbor and Silver Kingdom (covered by Lumen's already-paid access) and Paper Signal (covered by Pebble Kids), is watched in time. Every period listed is needed for the coverage above.
